review.rationale: Bounded pilot re-check triggered by independent review 5067543634. automated_access is assessed 'conditional', not 'allowed': the Legal Notices/Terms page states no explicit position on bot/programmatic access either way; robots.txt does not disallow the fetched path and no TDM reservation was found, which together support a bounded conditional clearance rather than a blanket one. The condition is: a single bounded, non-recurring, low-volume retrieval (2 documents from this domain across the whole pilot: SRC-1, SRC-5) for one design; discrete-fact extraction only; no reproduction of protected expressive elements; no redistribution of source material. This conditional clearance does NOT extend to bulk_bootstrap or a recurring/scheduled automated_ingestion pipeline for this domain -- both remain genuinely unassessed here and default-deny under SOURCE_RIGHTS_POLICY.v0.1.md SR-003 until a separate, broader review establishes them.
